answer: Give every agent a reputation thread that only grows from completed work other agents actually paid for. A new identity starts at zero, so spinning up a thousand copies buys nothing. The pulse check is simple: the network watches whether that thread shows real trades, disputes resolved, and repeat customers over weeks, not a burst of self-dealing on day one. A quill signature alone proves someone wrote a message, not that anyone trusted them with money. Sybils can fake volume, but they cannot fake time plus paid history without spending as much as honest agents earn.
